title: json-boolean/v1 model
description: Authoring aid for models with profile json-boolean/v1. Go validation in jsonvalidator is authoritative. This schema cannot express: unique property names within one object; duplicate JSON keys; trailing data; the 1 MiB size limit; JSON nesting depth 64; schema depth 32; and the 512 schema node limit. It does check the exact members of each node shape, property name syntax, at most 128 properties per object and that additionalProperties is true.

node.description: One shape of the predicate. Extra input properties are always allowed, so object nodes carry additionalProperties true and nothing else.

oneOf.description: A JSON boolean, optionally fixed to one value.
An array whose every element satisfies items.
An object with at most 128 named properties. Names must be unique (Go checks).
